$comment-purpose: Flow's own self-configuration. Flow is a Claude Code plugin (library / docs project) with no runtime to verify and no UI surface. Setting platform=library and uiSurface=false makes /flow:verify-build and /flow:accessibility-review skip cleanly at their respective platform/surface checks. defaultBranch is explicit to skip git symbolic-ref resolution. All other slots use schema defaults (paths under dev-docs/, no preflightCmd / typecheckCmd since flow is markdown + Python stdlib with no compile step).
$comment-referenceGlob: REQUIRED here, and not merely cosmetic (FB-0075). The schema default is 'core-docs/*.md', which does not exist in this repo -- flow keeps its reference docs in dev-docs/. Without this slot the /flow:critique-plan preprocessor resolved zero reference documents and injected NO '## Reference documents' section at all, silently: the critic could not cite a single project rule, and the result was indistinguishable from 'there were no rules to violate'. critique-plan/SKILL.md has asserted "flow's own repo overrides to dev-docs/*.md" since v1.x while this file did not; the claim was simply false. Caught by dogfooding a forked critique run in this session.
